source.quote: Chord Qutest user manual, read 2026-11-20: USB type B 32-bit/768 kHz PCM and up to DSD512; two BNC coaxial at 24-bit/384 kHz, reaching 768 kHz only in the dual-data mode that pairs with the maker's own upscaler; optical 24-bit/192 kHz, DSD64. Note that several retailer listings give the optical input as 96 kHz; the manual is the figure taken here.
